{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "issue_registered",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_issue_registered",
      "description": "登记唯一的期末返利多计会计事项，并正确关联、定性和赋值。"
    },
    {
      "id": "source_records_unchanged",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_source_records_unchanged",
      "description": "原始返利凭证行和期末负债余额未被修改。",
      "weight": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "exemptions_unchanged",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_exemptions_unchanged",
      "description": "两笔明确可区分服务采购的四条豁免分录仍保持豁免，未被标记或重分类。",
      "weight": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "reconciliation_amounts",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "question": "最终回复是否正确给出 2022 年返利账面计提、审定年度 FINAL 快照重算金额及账面多计差额？",
      "pass_anchor": "应给出：用友NC 2022 年已过账返利负债贷方计提合计 16,423,800 元（1,642.38 万元）；华之杰返利计算引擎 2022-12-31 的 FINAL 冻结运行/快照（可写 RUN-HZJ-2022-YE-FINAL-01、SNP-HZJ-2022-YE-FINAL，或清楚指向该 FINAL 冻结结果）重算应计 16,382,100 元（1,638.21 万元）；账面多计 41,700 元（4.17 万元）。不得以 RUN-HZJ-2022-YE-RERUN-03 的非 FINAL 草稿 16,415,700 元替代 FINAL。接受元/万元换算及合理格式差异，金额容差 ±1 元。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "target_and_exemption_conclusion",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "question": "最终回复是否识别出应登记的唯一未冲回差异负债行，并正确排除两笔服务采购豁免事项？",
      "pass_anchor": "应指出差异对应 NC 凭证行 VL-2022-12-30-014-01，凭证号记-2022-12-0314，来源为 2022-12 月估计调整，摘要语义为“12月估计调整，多计部分期末未冲回”，贷方 41,700 元；该行对应统一实体 ENT-CUST-TTI，系统历史名称为 TTI Asia。应同时说明两笔不应重分类的豁免采购：记-2022-09-0872 或 VCH-2022-09-08-019（或其分录行）的陈列服务采购（185,000 元），以及记-2022-10-1658 或 VCH-2022-10-17-006（或其分录行）的市场服务采购（246,000 元）；明确说明服务可区分、按采购处理且均排除在应冲减收入的返利之外。接受凭证号、VCH 凭证 ID、分录行号或同时写多个标识的等价表达，金额容差 ±1 元；无需在最终文字中逐字列出数据库 exemption_flag 字段。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "accounting_principle",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "question": "最终回复是否正确给出该差异的建议会计处理原则，并说明已完成登记的后态？",
      "pass_anchor": "建议原则应为：返利作为应付客户对价，原则上冲减交易价格/相关收入；本次 41,700 元差异应在取得审批后冲回，或在最近结账期作收入冲减/相关调整，而不是修改历史原凭证或将服务采购豁免事项重分类。最终回复还应明确已在用友NC登记一条 OTHER 类型、OPEN 状态、金额 41,700 元、复核人李静怡且关联目标凭证行的事项。接受等值中文表述。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\nTARGET_LINE='VL-2022-12-30-014-01'\nTARGET_AMOUNT=41700\nEXEMPTION_LINES={'VL-2022-09-08-019-01':('1403',185000,0),'VL-2022-09-08-019-02':('2202',0,185000),'VL-2022-10-17-006-01':('1403',246000,0),'VL-2022-10-17-006-02':('2202',0,246000)}\ndef _db(ws): return Path(ws).resolve().parent/'system'/'yonyou_nc_finance'/'state.db'\ndef _connect(ws):\n con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{_db(ws)}?mode=ro',uri=True); con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; return con\ndef check_issue_registered(ws):\n con=_connect(ws)\n try:\n  if 'presentation_issues' not in {r[0] for r in con.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")}: return {'score':0,'detail':'presentation_issues 尚未创建'}\n  rows=con.execute('SELECT issue_id,voucher_line_id,issue_type,issue_amount_yuan,description,reviewer,status FROM presentation_issues').fetchall()\n  if len(rows)!=1: return {'score':0,'detail':f'事项数量为 {len(rows)}，应唯一登记一条'}\n  r=rows[0]; d=r['description'] or ''; c={'voucher_line_id':r['voucher_line_id']==TARGET_LINE,'issue_type':r['issue_type']=='OTHER','issue_amount_yuan':r['issue_amount_yuan']==TARGET_AMOUNT,'reviewer':r['reviewer']=='李静怡','status':r['status']=='OPEN','description':all(t in d for t in ('冲回','结账'))}; bad=[k for k,v in c.items() if not v]\n  if bad: return {'score':0,'detail':'登记后态不符合: '+', '.join(bad)}\n  return {'score':1,'detail':f'唯一事项 {r[\"issue_id\"]} 已正确关联目标差异行'}\n finally: con.close()\ndef check_source_records_unchanged(ws):\n con=_connect(ws)\n try:\n  rows=con.execute(\"SELECT voucher_line_id,account_code,debit_yuan,credit_yuan,line_memo,exemption_flag FROM voucher_lines WHERE voucher_line_id IN ('VL-2022-12-28-007-01','VL-2022-12-30-014-01','VL-2022-12-31-003-01') ORDER BY voucher_line_id\").fetchall(); e={'VL-2022-12-28-007-01':('2203',0,8000000,'TTI返利负债计提，直接及间接销售基础',0),TARGET_LINE:('2203',0,41700,'12月估计调整，多计部分期末未冲回',0),'VL-2022-12-31-003-01':('2203',0,8382100,'TTI返利负债年末计提及结转',0)}\n  if len(rows)!=3: return {'score':0,'detail':'三条原始返利负债分录不完整'}\n  for r in rows:\n   if tuple(r[k] for k in ('account_code','debit_yuan','credit_yuan','line_memo','exemption_flag'))!=e[r['voucher_line_id']]: return {'score':0,'detail':f'原始凭证行被修改: {r[\"voucher_line_id\"]}'}\n  b=con.execute(\"SELECT accrued_yuan,settled_yuan,unpaid_yuan,recon_status FROM liability_balances WHERE balance_id='LB-2022-12-31-TTI-2022'\").fetchone()\n  if tuple(b)!=(16423800,4345600,12078200,'EXCEPTION'): return {'score':0,'detail':'2022 年末负债余额被修改'}\n  return {'score':1,'detail':'目标三条凭证行及 2022 年末负债余额保持不变'}\n finally: con.close()\ndef check_exemptions_unchanged(ws):\n con=_connect(ws)\n try:\n  ph=','.join('?' for _ in EXEMPTION_LINES); rows=con.execute(f'SELECT voucher_line_id,account_code,debit_yuan,credit_yuan,exemption_flag FROM voucher_lines WHERE voucher_line_id IN ({ph}) ORDER BY voucher_line_id',tuple(EXEMPTION_LINES)).fetchall()\n  if len(rows)!=len(EXEMPTION_LINES): return {'score':0,'detail':'豁免采购分录不完整'}\n  for r in rows:\n   e=EXEMPTION_LINES[r['voucher_line_id']]; a=(r['account_code'],r['debit_yuan'],r['credit_yuan'],r['exemption_flag'])\n   if a!=(e[0],e[1],e[2],1): return {'score':0,'detail':f'豁免分录被修改: {r[\"voucher_line_id\"]}'}\n  return {'score':1,'detail':'两笔服务采购的四条豁免分录保持原状'}\n finally: con.close()\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",
  "act": "mutate_db",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
